nodes.label: ADR 0002: Autenticacao propria sem senha
nodes.rationale: Own Go auth (Google/Discord OAuth + magic link), no passwords: managed providers cost per MAU and cause lock-in; no password to leak; Discord is where RPG groups live.

nodes.label: ADR 0003: Formulas da Ficha em Go compilado para WASM
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003: formulas da ficha em go compilado para wasm
nodes.rationale: Single Go formula evaluator compiled to WASM so UI and server never diverge. Rejected: dual TS+Go evaluators (divergence), frontend-only (backend would accept unvalidated values).

nodes.label: ADR 0004: RAG agentico com busca hibrida
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004: rag agentico com busca hibrida
nodes.rationale: Agentic RAG with hybrid search; Visibility applied in SQL. Rejected CAG (per-person cache, invalidation, cost grows with campaign) and hybrid CAG->RAG (two retrieval paths).

nodes.label: ADR 0005: Servidor MCP remoto com OAuth proprio
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005: servidor mcp remoto com oauth proprio
nodes.rationale: Remote MCP over Streamable HTTP with own OAuth 2.1 AS; BYO AI cost, product data, study goal. Access rules must live in tool registry, not Assistant loop, or MCP would escape them.

nodes.label: Agentic RAG
nodes.rationale: Model gets search tools and decides when/what to search, possibly multiple times.

nodes.label: River job queue (in Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Queue inside Postgres, no Redis; enqueued in same transaction as Note write.

nodes.label: Embeddings (1024-d, Voyage input_type document/query)
nodes.rationale: Changing embedding model requires full reindex.

nodes.label: HNSW index (pgvector)
nodes.rationale: Filter-before-search; hnsw.iterative_scan if volume grows.

nodes.label: Voyage AI embeddings
nodes.rationale: Anthropic offers no embeddings; Voyage is recommended partner.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Postgres principal, Mongo para documentos isolados
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: postgres principal, mongo para documentos isolados
nodes.rationale: Mongo only holds single-owner documents (Conversation, battle map) so it can't leak Notes across roles; Postgres holds anything under Visibility, billing or referential integrity. Mongo kept for learning. Rejected: Notes/Sheets in Mongo (no cross-db transaction with permissions), Postgres-only (learning goal).

nodes.label: Hybrid search (vector + full-text)
nodes.rationale: Vector finds paraphrases, full-text finds proper names; each covers the other's gaps.

nodes.label: Chunking (~400 tokens, ~50 overlap, context header)
nodes.rationale: Context header improves retrieval of short chunks.

nodes.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60)
nodes.rationale: No need to calibrate scores of different nature.

nodes.label: Monolito modular (rpgnote api/worker)
nodes.rationale: Single Go binary with api and worker subcommands, same Docker image; modules communicate via Go interfaces, never other modules' tables.

nodes.label: MCP primitives: Tools, Resources, Prompts
nodes.rationale: Difference is who controls: model (Tools), user/host (Resources), user (Prompts).

nodes.label: evals/rag evaluation set (retrieval, answer, leakage)
nodes.rationale: RAG without evaluation is trial and error; leakage tests are blocking.

nodes.label: readable_note(user_id) SQL predicate
nodes.rationale: Visibility predicate written once in SQL and JOINed by all Note/chunk queries, so prompt injection cannot leak secrets.

nodes.norm_label: consent: scopes notes:read/notes:write x authorized campanhas

nodes.label: OAuth 2.1 authorization server (PKCE S256, DCR, CIMD)
nodes.norm_label: oauth 2.1 authorization server (pkce s256, dcr, cimd)
nodes.rationale: PKCE prevents intercepted code exchange; audience bound via RFC 8707; tokens stored hashed.
